snippet.title: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Thirty masterpieces, nearly twenty-eight thousand pieces, and every single one of them is on the floor. Put the museum back together in a cozy first-person jigsaw game: as the Curator, with a few tricks up your sleeve, or on the Night Watch, with nothing but a good eye.

Out 27 October on Steam for Windows and macOS.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5272850/Piecework_The_Jigsaw_Museum/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announce&utm_content=a1
